meaning.zh:
“像 ABC 一样简单”，表示某事非常简单、易于理解或完成。

这个短语源于最基本的英文教育，从字母表的 ABC 开始教学，因此被认为是最初和最简单的知识。随着时间的推移，“As easy as ABC” 成为了一种常见的表达，用以说明某个过程或任务非常容易。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the very basic English education, starting with the alphabet ABC, considered the initial and simplest knowledge. Over time, "As easy as ABC" has become a common expression to indicate that a process or task is very easy.

lines.en: Learning how to use this phone is *as easy as ABC*.
lines.zh: 学习使用这款手机非常简单，像 ABC 一样容易。

lines.en: Solving this puzzle was *as easy as ABC*.
lines.zh: 解这个谜题如同 ABC 一样简单。

lines.en: Setting up the new printer was *as easy as ABC*.
lines.zh: 安装新的打印机非常简单，像 ABC 一样轻松。
